capabilities: Show daily prayer times for Iranian cities in a right-sidebar view
Calculate prayer times offline from bundled city data and local solar calculations
Search cities by city, county/province, or state and save favorites
Display the next prayer and countdown in the status bar
Configure calculation methods such as Tehran, Jafari, ISNA, MWL, and Umm al-Qura
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. A Persian README is also provided. The README includes privacy and troubleshooting sections and states no location or vault data is sent to external services.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to see daily Islamic prayer times without calling an external prayer-time API.
summary: Persian-first, offline Islamic prayer times view for Iranian cities, calculated locally from a bundled city dataset.
